description: Paths with coordinates near the top of the f32 range, each in its own 120x120 cell. Top row, hairlines (width 1) under Skia's limit: a line and a separate quadratic with its control point at 8e37 (every point it evaluates is finite, so both draw); a closed contour whose first segment is a cubic with control points at +-8e37, which Skia's hair_cubic skips because a point it evaluates overflows (SkScan_Hairline.cpp: a curve draws only when every point is finite), so the line after it and the closing line to the contour's first point still draw; the same contour round-capped (the segments of a closed contour take no cap); and a round-capped open polyline broken by that cubic, whose lines take a cap only at the contour's start and end (beside the break the neighbouring verb is the cubic, not a move). Bottom row, past Skia's limit: SkDraw::drawDevPath draws nothing when the device path's bounds pass a quarter of the f32 range (SkPathPriv::TooBigForMath), so a hairline line with a quadratic at 3e38, a hairline closed contour with a cubic at +-3e38, a filled triangle with a vertex at 1e38 and a width-3 line to 1e38 leave their cells empty.
toleranceNote: The hairlines overflow tiny-skia's finiteness test, so they go through the port of Skia's hair_path (hairline.rs) into tiny-skia's line hairliner (Skia's), and what remains is rounding in blending and coverage. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently.
